reviews.text: I received excellent service and we recommend it.
Very calm and very pet friendly
The best service all staff , the best doctors Cristian Perales  y Maria Elena , I’m very happy with the service.Danny have the best doctors .
The doctor provides excellent service; you can arrive even without an appointment and they will attend to you.

​Fantastic vet clinic! The front desk staff is super friendly and efficient. They are so gentle and sweet with my Bambi, and the vet always takes the time to thoroughly explain procedures and care plans. Highly recommend bringing your fur babies here!
Dr. Christian Perales and his team are the best; very professional and kind with our four legged babies.
I love west miami animal clinic. I have been taking my dogs there since puppies.  The doctor even saved the life of my male boxer. I love their team. Treat you with professionalism and kindness.

An amazing team from front dest to provider. They always go above and beyond for our babies and I am very thankful for them. Richard and Dr. Parales are very knowledgeable and very trustworthy would recommend!
Good location, w reserved parking spaces.The staff are the best here Dr. Perales & Richard are awesome  and sincerely appreciate how kind they treat Taylor Everytime he comes in. Thank you guys! 🙏😊 …

I have been bringing my dogs here for over 10 years, and honestly, I think that says a lot because my dogs are my children. ❤️🐾

I truly appreciate how patient, compassionate, and caring the entire staff has always been. The doctors take the time to listen to our concerns, explain everything thoroughly, and make us feel heard and comfortable. The front desk staff is always welcoming, friendly, and helpful, and you can tell that everyone genuinely cares about the animals they treat.

Over the years, they have been there for my girls through routine visits and everything in between, and I am incredibly grateful for the care, love, and kindness they have shown them. Finding a veterinarian you trust with your fur babies is so important, and I feel very fortunate to have found that here.
Thank you to the entire team for everything you have done for my girls over the years. I truly appreciate you all and highly recommend this practice to anyone looking for a veterinary team that treats your pets like family! ❤️🐶🐾
Extremely patient and very considerate. Thorough with their analysis and explanations. Normally on time with their appointments.
Excellent work by all the doctors and assistants. They are professional but very humane with the animals. It's a pleasure to come to this hospital.

Good afternoon. I didn't want to miss the opportunity to comment on the wonderful clinical team led by Dr. Christian Perales. I am so grateful for his incredible work saving lives on four paws. I've been visiting his clinic for over 15 years, treating both cats and dogs. He always does a fantastic job as a doctor and as a human being. I took Frida Ravelo, a dog with mammary cancer, to his clinic, and she was operated on by his team. His words were, "It was a miracle." Given her health problems and age, there wasn't much hope, but I will always follow him as a good doctor and for his love of his profession. I thank God, life, and him for saving what I love most in my life, just as he has done for other animals. Wherever you are and wherever you go, my four paws will follow you. May God be with you, your family, and your kind heart. Thank you, I will always be grateful. You have no idea how you made me feel, knowing I was able to give Frida a new life. I love you, baby, and I hope to have you for many more years. More time thanks to everything... greetings, good luck friend
Great service and great people!
Been going here for years. They’re great! Highly recommend.
They are quick and good at caring for dogs and cats

My dog ​​arrived very sick. The day before, I took him to the emergency room, but it wasn't like this West Miami Animal Hospital. Honestly, everything here was wonderful because my dog ​​was very ill, and thanks to everyone's help and attention, he has been improving. The kindness and care are the best. The doctor is a very good doctor, attentive and humane, as is the receptionist and the staff. They all deserve 5 stars. Thank you and blessings to everyone for all your help and service at this clinic. For me, it deserves 5 stars. Thank you.
We were seen quickly and our cat was handled with great care
The best clinic! I've been recommending them for 7 years. I take my dog ​​there; they have excellent services and are very attentive. 🥰

I would like to thanks Doctor Cristian Perales and the entire staff of west Miami animal hospital for his amazing job with Cesar today! I would not trust anybody else with the care of my beloved Cesar ! I will always recommend you ! 100% guaranteed !

I’ve been coming here for about 5 years! The doctors are compassionate, knowledgeable, and always provide exceptional care! Their professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine concern for animals make every visit a positive experience!

Dr Cristian and staff is super caring and have a great service . So grateful and coming back with Tulu for any follow up or urgent visits.

Thank You❤️🐾
Very good service. Satisfied.  Very professional

Excellent service, quick and efficient.
Recommend it
I love is my first experience in this veterinary hospital the team very professional the place is super clean and Tai super nice very professional and offer the special support
The staff is friendly and so loving to our pets.  Our nurse Kai was so great, explaining the billing and caring for our pet.

I wouldn't trust another vet! They have truly helped all of our pets in the kindest and most professional ways. Our entire family take multiple pets to them. Dr. Perales is amazing!

Came back to say Tai - Dr. Perales’ newest nurse is an angel! She’s so thorough and honest. She takes care of our dog like her own.

I have been coming here for years for my golden retriever, the service is always phenomenal and they really care about your pet. Tai is super friendly and attentive and helped calm down my dog before his appointment, I highly recommend.
Lovely service here, they nurses take good care of the dogs, especially Tai
Great vet service! Tai is an amazing vet tech, shes super attentive and caring!!

Been coming to this vet for almost 30 years! We now see Dr Perales and we love him! He is very knowledgeable and very good with my fur baby! We met Tai today and Lola seems to approve! We highly recommend 🐾 …
Tai was my nurse the doctor was amazing
Tai was very sweet and bubbly! She was great help with my dog. I really appreciated everything.

I had an excellent experience at West Miami Hospital, and I especially want to recognize Melissa at the front desk for her outstanding customer service. From the moment I arrived, she was professional, welcoming, and incredibly helpful, making the entire process smooth and stress-free. Melissa always goes above and beyond to assist patients, answer questions, and ensure everyone feels cared for and respected. Her positive attitude, patience, and dedication truly set her apart, and she is without a doubt one of the best CSRs I have ever encountered. West Miami Hospital is lucky to have someone like Melissa representing their team.
I highly recommend this clinic , Melissa has great attention and dc.perales is the best doctor I’ve ever met! I highly recommend them for everyone’s pets
Melissa, the girl in front, provided excellent service. The doctor was very attentive and kind to my pets. I highly recommend them.
Nice services

They are excellent. I've been taking my two pets to the clinic for eight years, and they've always been very professional and attentive. Thank you, doctor, and the staff for taking such good care of my pets and giving them such great attention.
Amazing customer service I took my kitten for vaccines and it went smoothly. The nurse Tai and Dr. Perales were both amazing!

I have been going to Dr. Perales with my dogs for the entire time his office has been open, 9 years I think. He has now cared for my first and second dog, as well as bringing my third dog back to heath after I found her on the street. Dr. Perales’ seat in heaven is already reserved alongside all the other animals and families he has helped along the way. He is truly a saint. His skills as a veterinarian and diagnostician is no doubt in the top 1%. I have referred numerous animal parents to him and they all speak so highly of him so I know I am not biased. He truly is the best veterinarian in all of Miami and will treat you and your animals right. I am so grateful for all he has done to keep my pups healthy, I only wish I could find a doctor for myself as trustworthy and caring. Thank you, Dr. Perales. My family is forever indebted to you.
Excellent service and fantastic results! He gave my Chihuahua, Sofia, a prophylaxis and left her feeling brand new. Dr. Cristian is the best, 100% recommended!
Thank you so much!

I’ve been a loyal client for 7&1/2 years and I love this place. I currently live in NJ and flew down for them to operate on my lil guy today. I do not trust anyone but West Miami to touch him. I’m grateful for them so much and the care they take
I got my vaccinations today, I'm happy, their service is always 10/10
Did a great job helping us with the birth of our dogs puppies! I would recommend them to any pet owners in the West Miami area.
Thank you so much Mabel.
Highly recommended. Reasonable prices, very professional doctors, and a friendly team. My first experience here. Recommended.
Excellent service, very friendly, and very good prices.

Wonderful veterinary office! The staff was kind, professional, and truly caring. The vet was excellent, and the vet’s assistant, Jose, was especially helpful, compassionate, and attentive. You can tell they all genuinely care about the animals they treat. Highly recommend!

Horrible horrible experience. I brought my cat in for a possible urgent issue and paid for an exam, but was given absolutely no guidance.

Unless I agreed to pay $748 for diagnostics, I was told nothing. I had to ask twice to even speak with the doctor, and when I finally did, I got told “I don’t know” with a shrug and no direction on whether this was an emergency or what to do next.

Essentially paid for a visit where my cat was weighed, but without a single useful answer or any guidance. Completely frustrating and not acceptable. Do not waste your time or money.

Even though I now live in Broward and the clinic is a bit far from home, I still bring my dog here for his yearly checkups because the care is always excellent. Dr. Perales is wonderful, professional, knowledgeable, and truly caring.

Jose, his assistant, was also great and treated my dog with so much care. Thank you so much! It’s always worth the drive!🐶❤️ 🐾
The Team at West Miami Animal Hospital are great. Always caring. The Dr. ,Jose and the team. The best
Jose was amazing. Thank you
Many thanks to Jose!
José was wonderful! Very knowledgeable, kind and explained the processes and services needed very well. We will definitely be back!!
Thanks to Jose
The doctor is excellent. I've been with them for 9 years. They are very attentive, and their staff is very professional and helpful, especially José.
Great vet office, have taken our kitties there for years.
Jose was the most helpful and understanding tech with my reactive dog. I appreciate his patience as well as the rest of the staff, they are great!
Very happy with the service. Thank you Jose and all the staff
Kindness, empathy, cleanliness, and lovely people—doctors, nurses, and staff in general. For Jose
José and the rest of the team did an amazing job with our dog’s first visit. They made him feel comfortable and provided the lab results immediately after completing.

I had such a great experience at West Miami Animal Hospital. The staff is always welcoming, professional, and truly caring with my pet. You can tell they genuinely love what they do.

Both Dr. Perales and Dr. Ramos are amazing doctors. They are knowledgeable, patient, and take the time to explain everything clearly. They never rush appointments and always make sure all my questions are answered. I feel completely comfortable trusting them with my pet’s health.

I highly recommend this animal hospital to anyone looking for compassionate and experienced veterinarians in the West Miami area! 🐾
The doctor is very dedicated to his patients and has excellent human qualities towards his animals.

I have been coming here to this animal hospital frequently at least 1x a week for my dog to get regular treatments. Im always greeted at the door by Melissa all the time. When it comes to examination, Dr. Perales always comes in greeting us and examines my dog and does a wellness check. She had a variety of situations that Dr. Perales had taken care of from maintaining her arthritis to handling a double ear infection that occurred in the groomers. The faculty in this facility have taken my dog's health and quality of life very seriously.

Don’t waste your time here.

My dog ate cooked bones yesterday, he threw them up already. But I just want to make sure none remain in him. So I just needed a simple X-Ray. I was told the only way to get the price of that was paying the $30 initial consultation. This I will never understand, as they should be transparent with the prices prior. Don’t bring your dog here it’s a money grab. I would have had no problem paying the $30 with just some simple ball park numbers.
José provided excellent service!!
Thank you so much Yamila!

Jose and the Dr Cristian Perales are wonderful with our Spanish Galgo , they took the time to explain the best approach for her in regards to her condition , they welcome us and very attentive to her needs and care , we have try multiple Dr and we feel he and the whole time of Animal West Hospital are the best

I am deeply grateful for the service, care, and professionalism of the doctor and his entire team at West Miami Animal Hospital. My dog, Sasha, required emergency care at the clinic due to pyometra, a very serious uterine infection that was life-threatening. From the very first moment, the receptionist was incredibly kind, empathetic, and attentive, helping us stay calm during such a distressing situation.

Despite the delicate nature of Sasha's condition, the doctor and his team acted quickly and precisely. His medical assistant was also incredibly professional, careful, and always willing to answer our questions, which gave us great peace of mind throughout the entire process.
Due to the advanced stage of the infection and Sasha's small size, the surgery carried significant risks. However, thanks to the doctor's expertise and the team's constant monitoring, the surgery was a success, and today my dog ​​is healthy and recovering.

I am immensely grateful for the care, dedication, and commitment with which Sasha was treated during such a critical time. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic to any pet owner, especially for surgical procedures. Dr. Perales has extensive experience and his professionalism is truly trustworthy.
Dr. Perales was great and very transparent about care options. Melissa and Sabrina at the front desk were super friendly and helpful!

Dr. Perales is a very good doctor (an exceptional doctor), and Melissa, the girl across the hall, was very helpful.
Everyone is very attentive and caring towards the pets during their appointments.
Dr. Christian and his crew are amazing. They are professional and we've been bringing out pups for a decade. Keep up the good work
Melissa & Illiana were very helpful and courteous.  good customer service

Today I was greeted by Iliana at the front desk and she helped me get the meds refills for my furry babies with the same caring and professionalism they always do. Thanks Iliana and happy Thanksgiving to Dr. postales and his team 🙏 …
Iliana is the best!!!!
I really enjoyed the service. The receptionist, Melissa, was incredibly kind and attentive, just like my little one. Dr. Perales was also wonderful and patient with my child. 100% recommended.
Melissa and Iliana
Excellent service, Dr. Perales was very pleasant and attentive to my dog, the staff was also very friendly, 100/10 recommended. Very convenient prices, totally worth it.
Highly recommended to anyone who wants to give their furry little ones the best care. Excellent doctors. Thank you!
This is the best and we are super grateful to the staff 😁 …

The front staff were very polite and attentive. Dr. Christian Perales was very knowledgeable and took the time to listen and explain any concerns I had with my cat. He is very passionate in veterinary medicine and it shows in how he interacted my cat. I would highly recommend bringing your pet here!
Giving Lunita Laser Therapy

Excellent veterinary services. We are very grateful to Dr. Cristian Perales, a great professional and, above all, someone with a wonderful heart for animals. Whenever my furry daughter has needed his medical services, the results have been excellent.

The front desk is very sweet and seam to be very  inviting. the initial visit is really affordable. Until they hit you with a super expensive bill of things your pet does not need. I agreed to the charges hoping my pet would get better and it didn’t happen, they keep calling for follow up’s to scam me for more money. It’s a shame people like this are in business.
This place is great. Staff is friendly and have taken great care of my doggie. Prices are always fair and I am truly happy to have discovered this animal hospital.
Excellent service..🥰🥰. Thank you, Dr. Perales. …

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Review for West Miami Animal Hospital

I am incredibly grateful to West Miami Animal Hospital for the excellent care they have given my dog, Thor ❤️ He recently had surgery, and I have no words to describe how well they have cared for him from the very first moment.

From the moment we arrived, the two women at the front desk greeted us with wonderful hospitality. Their warmth and professionalism made me feel comfortable immediately.

Dr. Perales and his assistant have been impeccable. Their dedication, love for animals, and commitment to their work are evident. They have kept me informed every step of the way and have treated Thor with immense affection.

I am so happy and grateful for the care, attention, and respect they have shown at all times. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. If you love your pet and want the best for them, West Miami Animal Hospital is the place to go.

Thank you so much for everything you've done for Thor!
🐾💙

I love bringing my baby Basil here! The staff is always really nice and professional and the Doctor is always attentive. We are doing laser therapy on her and it is working miracles. 100% recommend❤️❤️❤️🙏☺️🌭 🐕 …
Very reliable, I was recommended by some coworkers who have their pets treated there. Thank you for your attention, especially from Dr. Pelares.
They're the best! The prices are very good and quite affordable, and Dr. Perales is very nice.
Afforable prices! Drs are very helpfull, amazing service, thanks For everything
Very expensive 💲 …
The place is clean and nice, but it's incredibly expensive. What would cost me $15 anywhere else cost me over $50 there. There are much better places to take pets.
Very attentive

Dr. Perales is a professional with a genuine vocation and dedication to the comprehensive health of our pets. I took my cat, Princess, to him for diagnosis and treatment, and she's doing well. I recommend his services 100%. Thank you, Dr. Perales.
I've been looking for the best and honest veterinarian...and I found it!!! My dog got the best care!!!

100% recommended! Dr. Christian is amazing! His kindness is incredible; he explains everything in detail and gives different recommendations according to your budget and your dog's condition. The entire staff is excellent with their attention and service. My dog ​​Conga almost passed away last year, and West Animal Hospital gave her every possible care, and she's still with us today…
Good service

West Miami Animal Hospital has been wonderful. My 16- year old dog was seriously I'll with kidney and liver issues. They were able to stabilize her and develop a plan to keep her healthy. I'm happy to say it's been two years and my Mona is doing great under their care. She is playing with her toys like a puppy.
Best vet clinic in the world,  thank so much.

Best place in all Miami area to take care of your pets, they go the extra mile for that, and you dont eveb notice,  great doctors that know what are they are doing,  great staff,  top notch equipment,  you can trust your love one here. Thank.

I've been taking my dogs here for years and have nothing but wonderful things to say about the staff and doctors. They're all friendly, compassionate, and professional. I take my dog in several times a week for treatment and everyone knows her by name.

I've been a client of this veterinary office since 2020. I find the doctors and staff very kind. I like how they treat my dogs, and their diagnoses and treatments have been very accurate. I trust them because they know how to treat small breed dogs! I recommend them to everyone I can.

My experience here at this clinic has been nothing short of absolutely AMAZING. I have never met such wonderful staff who met me with the utmost care, attention, support, and a genuine commitment to the well-being of their patients! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and reassured that my dog was in the best hands possible. The entire team goes above and beyond to ensure every visit is positive and stress-free. I hope this clinic never moves because I will be bringing my dog here forever!

The doctors here are compassionate, knowledgeable, and truly dedicated to providing exceptional care. They always take the time to explain everything clearly and ensure I feel confident about my dog's health and treatment. Dr. Ramos and Dr. Perales are absolute gems; their kindness, expertise, and love for animals are unmatched. I 100000% recommend bringing your pet here for top-notch care that you can trust.

The prices are reasonable and affordable, making quality veterinary care accessible without breaking the bank. Thank you once again for all the amazing care my dog and I received here. I am forever grateful for this incredible team and the peace of mind they provide!
